content: Ayesu bhaalumbalila Ayohana Ambatichaji
Ayesu pabhakajomola kwaalagianga bhaajigana bhenibhala komi na bhabhele bhakabhoka penapo, bhakajenda kujigana na kwaatangachianga bhandu Ngani Jammbone mu hilambo ya ku Galilaya.
Ayohana Ambatichaji pabhakibha kuchitabho bhakajoha hikubho hibhatenda Ayesu Kilisto. Ayohana ngabhaatuma bhabhaajigana bhabhe bhakaakonye Ayesu.
“Bholi, mwenga nga bhenibhala bhabhapakuhika, au twaalende bhangi?”
Ayesu bhakaajangula, “Nnyendange nkaalobholele Ayohana hikubho muijoine na kuilola,
bhangalola, bhatenda kulola, na bhabhi na mambujupuju bhatenda kulama, na bhangajoha bhatenda kujoha, bhabhawile bhatenda kuyoka na akaahocho bhatangachiwanga Ngani Jammbone.
Bhatekutendelwa gammbone bhenibhala bhandu bhangakolanga lipamba na nenga!”

Bhaajigana bha Ayohana pabhakajaulanga, Ayesu bhakajemeka kugalobholela malubhalo ga bhandu ngani nnani ja Ayohana, “Nkajaulanga kulola niki konikola kululemba? Bholi, nkapala kulilola linyai lilikajelwa kutali na mboongo?
Handa nga henela, nkajaulanga kulola niki? Nkajaulanga kwaalola mundu bhabhawalite ngobho ya bei ngolongwa? Bhandu bhawalanga ngobho ya bei ngolongwa hutamanga mu nyuumba ja akaakolo bha hilambo.
Nambo nkajaulanga kulola niki? Nkajaulanga kwaalola Alondoi? Kweli, ngabha, nga kupunda alondohi.
Jonojwe nga jwakalongelwa mu Majaandiko ga Annoongo, abhikulobhola ‘Ndendakwaatuma antumichi jwangu jwa kunani kwa Annoongo annongolelange, kwa kubhee bhapakunhalakia ndela jinu.’

Ndendakunnobholelanga kweli, pakati ja bhaana bhoa bha bhandu, bhangabhokela bhabhile akolo kupeta Ayohana Ambatichaji. Hata henela, bhenibhala bhabhile ahocho muno mu umwenye gwa kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo nga akolongwa kupunda Ayohana.

Kubhokela muda gwa Ayohana Ambatichaji mpaka nangocheni, umwenye gwa kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo gupetulikwa na bhandu bhabhi na machili, na bhandu bhabhilinge na machili bhapalanga kugutola kwa machili.
Maana gakwe majigano goa na Malagilo ga Amusa gagajigana muda gwa Ayohana Ambatichaji.
Handa nkombolanga kujeketela kubhee Ayohana nga Aelia bhabhapakuhika
Bhabhilinge na machikilo gakujoa na bhajoange!”
“Bhandu bha nangocheni nichilandanikie na niki? Handa achikakombo bhatamitinge palubhanja pabhahuchilanga hilebhe na kuhemela hilebhe bhatendakutamanga na kwaakemanga akaajabhe na kwaalobholelanga,
‘Tumpotilinge ng'oma nambo mwangota mwangakina! Tujembite nyembo ya malilo nambo mwangota mwangagutanga kwa nnyembo gwa kokoleka!’
Ayohana akahika, akatabha na wala jwangang'wee divai, na bhenaangota bhakalobholanga, ‘Atekupoganikwa na mahoka gabohu!’

Mwana jwa Amundu akahika, akalyee na kung'wee, na bhenaangota bhakalobhola, ‘Munnolange hojo mundu jwakumenyeka na jwakung'wee muno, aganja bhabhe bhabhakumbanga kodi na bhabhilinge na mabohu!’ Hata henela Machili ga Annoongo gabhonekana gammbone kwa ndela ja hikubho yabhe.”
Hilambo ya bhandu bhangahobhalela
Kubhoka penapo, Ayesu bhakajemeka kwaalongelelanga mabhou bhandu bha hilambo yela, yakubhee pamo na kuitendela yakangachika hijingi, kwa kubhee bhandu bhabhe bhangapala kuleka mabhou gabhenji.

Akaalobholelanga, “Kulaga kupakubhee kwaachinu mwangota bhandu bha chilambo cha ku Kolasini! Kulaga kupakubhee kwa mwangota bhandu bha chilambo cha ku Betisaida! Kwa kubhee handa hikubho yakangachika hiikateendeka kwaachinu nga ikatendeka konikola ku chilambo cha Tilo na kuchilambo cha Sidoni, bhandu bhakwe bhakawala ngobho ja majunia, na kuchipakala lihu kulangia kubhee bhatenda kuleka mabohu gabhenji!
Nambo ndendakunnobholelanga, lichobha lya kuhukumulwa lipakubhee chindema muno kwa bhandu bha chilambo cha ku Tilo na chilambo cha ku Sidoni bhapakupatanga hukumulo ngolongwa kupeta mwangota.

Na mwangota, bhandu bha chilambo cha ku Kafalanaumu, bholi, bhapakuntuluanga mpaka kunani kwa Annoongo? Ngabha hopo, mpakutulukwa pahi mpaka kuwee. Hilebhe yakangachika hiikatendeka kwaachinu handa hikatendeka konokwe ku chilambo cha ku Sodoma, chilambo hecho chikabhee mpaka leleni!
Nambo nannobholela yakubhee, ipakubhee chindema muno kwachinu bhandu bha chilambo cha ku Sodoma kulaga mu lichobha lya kuhukumulwa kupeta mwenga!”
Nhikange kwaachangu Mpomolele

Gono muda Ayesu bhakalobhola, “Ndendakunchukulu mwee Atati, Hangwana bha kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo na chilambo, kwa kubhee ntekwaahiya hikubho heyo bhandu bhabhilinge na luunda na malango na mwenga ntekwahunukulila bhenibhala bhabhilinge handa bhaana bhachoko.
Elo, Atati, henela nga chimpalite hibhokele.”
“Atati bhangu bhambekie hilebhe yoha. Bhaakwa bhakwamanya mwana ila Atati, na wala bhakwamanya Atati ila mwana, na bhoa bhala yakubhee bhapala kuhunukumulilwa na mwana.”
“Nhikange kwaachangu mwangota bhoa chintenda kuhabhukanga na kutopelwa na mihigo, na nenga mbakumpomoleanga.
Ngoondange nenga, na nndumikilange nenga na nkachijigane kubhoka kwangu nenga, kwa kubhee nenga nga mundu bha kalipa na wala ngachipuna na mwangota mpakupomolelanga.
Kwa kubhee majigano nganannyigananga mwangota nga gakulimba.”
